# Cloudflare as Lego blocks: what changed in v1.1.0

26 unchanged paragraphs, under In short {#in-short}, What I want {#want}, The blocks {#blocks}

• **Workers AI.** 10,000 neurons a day free, then $0.011 per 1,000. Its catalogue lists 71 models, all marked Cloudflare-hosted, runningrunning,"onasGPUsthe [Workers AI overview](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/) puts it, on "GPUs on Cloudflare's network": Llama 4 Scout, gpt-oss-120b, Qwen 3, Kimi K2.6, Gemma 4, Mistral Small, DeepSeek, GLM, Whisper and image models among them.

9 unchanged paragraphs

• **Email Sending.** In beta since April,beta, on the paid plan: 3,000 emails a month, then $0.35 per 1,000.

10 unchanged paragraphs, under Which models stay inside Cloudflare {#models}, An sgit vault on Cloudflare {#vault}

**Read-write: 83 lines.** The vault API sgit talks to has seven endpoints: info, read, list, batch, write, delete and destroy.destroy, plus an auth check this Worker always answers. We wrote them as one Worker. Reads go straight to R2. Every write for a vault goes through that vault's Durable Object, which Cloudflare runs one request at a time, so the compare-and-swap that stops two pushes overwriting each other is atomic. The first write to a vault binds its write key, by keeping a SHA-256 of it; later writes must match.

17 unchanged paragraphs, under How a non-specialist sets it up {#setup}

1. **A Deploy to Cloudflare button.** A link that clones a public repository into the user's own account, creates the R2 bucket, Durable Objects and other resources it declares, builds and deploys. For a vault host, that is one click and a sign-in. It works for Workers, not Pages. 2. **A temporary account.** Since June, `wrangler deploy --temporary` deploys with no sign-up; it stays live for an hour, with a link to claim it as a real account. Good for trying something before committing to it. 3. **An agent, once.** Claude Code, or any agent with a terminal, signs in with `wrangler login` and its OAuth flow, runs the commands, and hands back the URL. Cloudflare also runs an MCP server for its whole API, so an agent can do it without the command line. A new command-line tool, `cf`, entered open beta on 28 September and will replace WranglerWrangler,overwhich Cloudflare will keep maintaining for 18 months after the nextbeta18 months;ends; a skill written today should say which it uses. 4. **The dashboard's own assistant.** Agent Lee, in beta, can change settings such as DNS records with your approval, but cannot deploy applications.
